description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, managing user interactions to trigger a notification service with a timer and message input.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for handling user input to start a notification ping service with a specified delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity and creates an intent to start PingService.

methods.name: onPingClick
methods.description: Handles button click event to get user input, configure the intent with message and delay, show toast, and start the PingService.
